title: Gan Naul

description: 18th-century work investigating Hebrew roots and their bases in Tanakh, focusing on the root “chakham” and its synonyms. Complete Jewish Thought text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Jewish philosophy and theology argue about God, revelation, law and the human good. These works belong to their own schools and arguments; the library does not flatten them into a single Jewish doctrine.
